summary: Android 8+ now draws the exact supplied composite artwork as a full-bleed adaptive background with a transparent foreground. This avoids shrinking the artwork's built-in rounded square into the safe-zone and producing a second inner frame. Existing density-specific PNGs remain unchanged for pre-API 26 devices.

checks.name: Android release build and adaptive resource packaging
checks.observation: Release build completed. Gradle release packaged_res contains mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml and drawable-nodpi-v4/ic_launcher_foreground.png; APK resources.arsc contains ic_launcher_background, ic_launcher_foreground and ic_launcher.

checks.name: APK signature verification
checks.observation: The earlier tracked release was verified with APK Signature Scheme v2 and upload certificate 394e369de2d566b4897493ee498da2f27745e514c49ca88c6489b0a811212b. apksigner is unavailable on this host, so the refreshed artifact's signature has not been independently verified.

checks.name: Compiled adaptive icon layer references
checks.observation: The earlier release used a color background and image foreground. The current full-bleed layer mapping is verified below in the refreshed build.

checks.name: Full-bleed artwork layer packaging
checks.observation: The release APK's adaptive icon background resource resolves to drawable/ic_launcher_foreground (the supplied 1024x1024 composite artwork), while the foreground resolves to fully transparent color/ic_launcher_transparent. Density-specific legacy mipmaps are unchanged.

checks.name: Google Pixel launcher visual acceptance
checks.observation: The Android 17 Pixel 7 had appeared on ADB earlier, but the ADB server subsequently failed with Operation not permitted. This APK was not installed on the device, so the reported white-frame appearance and standard/themed icon rendering remain unverified.

remaining: Independently verify the refreshed APK signature; install it on a Google Pixel; compare normal and themed launcher modes against Samsung; confirm the extra inner frame is gone without clipping the supplied artwork.
